_about: Kinds of painted scene for tools/painted/new_scene.py: how a kind is asked for, calibrated and lit. A brief (scenes/<id>.json) picks a kind and may override any key. Everything is English: this is tooling, not player text.

interior.composition: An enclosed room seen from just inside its entrance, looking across a large clear area of floor. Vaulted or beamed ceiling, walls of shelves and stone, light coming from a window, skylight or lamps.

street.composition: An outdoor street or lane of a small town seen from the middle of the way, looking along it: houses leaning in on both sides, a wide clear stretch of ground in the foreground to walk on, the sky and a bend or a far gate at the end.
street.palette: Natural world first, strange colour second: autumnal melancholy, moss green, dusky blue, plum shadows, warm lamplight in windows.

garden.composition: An enclosed outdoor garden seen from its gate or its path, looking in: beds, a stone path and wall, trees, a clear stretch of path and lawn in the foreground to walk on, open sky above.
garden.palette: Moss, dusky blue, plum shadows, warm late-afternoon light; a quiet place that is slightly too orderly.

cellar.composition: A low vaulted basement room reached by stairs, seen from the foot of the stairs: a clear stretch of stone floor in the foreground, arches, shelves and crates, the light only from a few lamps and one small opening.
cellar.palette: Dark and close, plum shadows, a violet and a deep blue lamp, small warm candles.

threshold.composition: The edge of the settled world: a path or field leading away from the foreground into thick pale fog, the far distance dissolving, almost nothing built, a clear stretch of path to walk on.
threshold.palette: Pale grey-white fog, dusky blue, a little moss and plum, one small point of warm or gold light.

firstperson.composition: Seen from eye height from behind a shop counter, looking out through a large window and its frame onto the street: the counter's edge and the window frame in the foreground, shelves at the sides, the street and its doorstep beyond the glass, a clear patch of doorstep for a visitor to stand on. No hands, no people.
firstperson.palette: Warm lamplight inside, dusky blue evening outside.
